bibl.title: Notes on P. Oxy. XXIX 2506: Comment on Lyric Poems.
bibl.seg: Martin Reinfelder, Notes on P. Oxy. XXIX 2506: Comment on Lyric Poems.
Frammenti sulla scena (online). Studi sul dramma antico frammentario 0 (2019) pp. 201-216.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. XXIX, 2506 (= MP3 1950; LDAB 193). Attempts to identify some new poetic fragments and to reconstruct several parts of the commentary and the passages of both lyric and dramatic poetry it quotes.
